cases.detail: IEEE 1800-2023 11.4.7 requires each logical equivalence operand to be evaluated exactly once. Verilator 5.052 evaluates the left function twice in the standalone reproduction and emits SIDEEFFECT warnings; Icarus 13.0 evaluates both functions once.
